# Quenching from 5000K to 1500K at 3.5 K/ps

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define potential
pair_style      tersoff
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature
compute         mytemp all temp

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# NPT ensemble settings
# Quenching from 5000K to 1500K at 3.5 K/ps
# Time needed: (5000-1500)/3.5 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps

fix             1 all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          10000

# Run quenching simulation
run             1000000

# Write final structure
write_data      final_structure.dat

print           "Quenching simulation completed"
"}
